ordered_diagnoses: Plakophilin-2 Mutation-Related Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy

s1.syndrome_frame: Intermittent palpitations with worsening over the previous hour, characterized by wide complex tachycardia and abnormal cardiac structure and function
salient_findings: Wide complex tachycardia at rate of 190 bpm
Grossly dilated RV with high RV end diastolic volume
key_facts: Male patient in his 20s
Complaints of intermittent palpitations for 2 days
Worsening of palpitations in the previous hour
No history of chest pain, dyspnea, congestion, or fever
No past cardiac history or family history of similar complaints
Blood pressure was 110/72 mm Hg
Respiratory rate was 14 bpm
ECG showed wide complex tachycardia with atypical left bundle branch morphology
QRS duration of 146 ms with no evidence of AV dissociation
Echocardiography showed global hypokinesia of right ventricle and dilated RV
Cardiac MRI showed grossly dilated RV and high RV end diastolic volume
Postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall and other areas
